title: box
body:
## box

Creates a native Part::Box: an axis-aligned rectangular solid whose minimum corner sits at origin and which extends length along +X, width along +Y and height along +Z, in millimetres. Choose it for plates, stock blanks and rectangular cut tools. It has no rotation option; for a block in another orientation extrude a rectangle or polygon along the required direction. Schemaxis always assigns all four settings (defaults: a 10 mm cube at the world origin), and the feature stays editable in the published FCStd.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- origin is the minimum corner, not the centre: to centre a 20 mm wide box on x = 0, set origin x to -10.
- As a cut tool, let the box overshoot the faces it should pass through; coincident faces make booleans fragile.
- Recorded native qualification for this route covers an analytic box and a height variant (qualification.json box-baseline and box-variant); it does not qualify every boolean that uses a box.

Native binding: `Part::Box`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | Edge length of the block along the world X axis, in millimetres (Part::Box Length); the block spans X from the origin corner to origin + length. Must be greater than 0. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `10` |
| `width` | Edge length of the block along the world Y axis, in millimetres (Part::Box Width); the block spans Y from the origin corner to origin + width. Must be greater than 0. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `10` |
| `height` | Edge length of the block along the world Z axis, in millimetres (Part::Box Height); the block spans Z from the origin corner to origin + height. Must be greater than 0. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `10` |
| `origin` | World coordinates [x, y, z] of the block's minimum corner (the Part::Box placement base, its front-left-bottom corner). The block extends from this point in the positive X, Y and Z directions; there is no rotation option. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
